owning_definition_quotes.quote:
Test a moving, untilted alternative to the closed tilted-spindle branch. Each of three coaxial planar rings is an antipodal electrino–positrino binary. The middle ring lies on the field-speed rail, $omega R_M=c_f$. Consecutive rings are separated so that

$$
\frac{z_{\rm gap}}{d}=\frac{u}{c_f}.
$$

For an adjacent source ring $a$ and trailing receiver ring $b$, the fixture sets

$$
d_{ab}=|R_b-R_a|,
\qquad
\Delta t_{ab}=\frac{d_{ab}}{c_f},
\qquad
z_{\rm gap}=u\Delta t_{ab},
\qquad
\phi_b=\phi_a-\omega\Delta t_{ab}.
$$

At the selected delayed root, the source emission point and receiver hit point therefore have the same azimuth. Their line of action is radial in the transverse plane, and its axial component is zero.

The declared search covers all six axial orders, both radial phase-match spacing branches on each gap, two inner-radius ratios, two outer-radius ratios, and three drift speeds. The short branch uses $d_{ab}=|R_b-R_a|$ with equal delayed-ray azimuth; the long branch uses $d_{ab}=R_a+R_b$ with opposite delayed-ray azimuth. For every row, the production-root forces are cycle averaged. The single global coupling is the least-squares coefficient for the three required radial accelerations,

$$
\kappa_\star
=
\frac{\sum_i f_i^{\rm raw}a_i^{\rm req}}
{\sum_i(f_i^{\rm raw})^2},
\qquad
a_i^{\rm req}=-\omega^2R_i.
$$

The dimensionless binding residual is

$$
\epsilon_{\rm bind}
=
\frac{\|\kappa_\star\mathbf f^{\rm raw}-\mathbf a^{\rm req}\|_2}
{\|\mathbf a^{\rm req}\|_2}.
$$
Binding requires $kappa_\star>0$ and $epsilon_{\rm bind}\le 0.03$. Pump freedom requires $|\tau_z|\le 0.02$.

owning_definition_quotes.quote:
The declared coarse search contains $288$ rows. Binding-only refinement selects the axial order $M\to I\to O$, the long spacing branch on both gaps, and

$$
u=0.48046875c_f,
\qquad
(R_I,R_M,R_O)=(0.99511719,1.25,1.87402344).
$$

The two gaps are

$$
(d_1,d_2)=(2.24511719,2.86914063),
\qquad
(z_1,z_2)=(1.07870865,1.37853241).
$$

The complete root record does not close. At the best positive global coupling,

$$
\kappa_\star=4.52636941,
\qquad
\mathbf R=(0.06849450,-0.02235171,-0.02879827),
$$

so

$$
\|\mathbf R\|_2=0.07759147,
\qquad
\epsilon_{\rm bind}=0.04922985.
$$

The complete record is also not pump-free:

$$
\tau_z=+13.37621958.
$$

**Measured:** the selected row reports

$$
\epsilon_{\rm bind}=0.0492298548241>0.03,
$$

with residual vector

$$
\mathbf R=(0.06849450,-0.02235171,-0.02879827)
$$

and pump $\tau_z=+13.37621958$.

owning_definition_quotes.quote:
This packet evaluates the free-particle candidate as one assembly from the start. No isolated-triple gate is present. The photon candidate is a neutral contra-rotating polarity-conjugate planar pair with no payload. The electron candidate is the same pair plus six explicit electrino worldlines in the axial pocket, with charge

$$
Q=6\left(-\frac{|e|}{6}\right)=-1e.
$$

Every selected row is tested with one common coupling $\kappa_\star$.

The best photon replay has
$\epsilon_{\rm bind}=0.9922225625$ and the electron rest target has
$\epsilon_{\rm bind}=0.9999927135$, both far outside the declared $0.03$ gate.

The best coarse photon row has $\kappa_\star=0.09446654050233466$, pump residual $3.71\times10^{-16}$, and binding residual $0.9916649426542679$. Its sampling ladder is

| Cycle samples | $\kappa_\star$ | $\epsilon_{\rm bind}$ | $|\tau_z|$ |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 3 | $0.1240934380$ | $0.9823877638$ | $3.65\times10^{-16}$ |
| 6 | $0.1240934380$ | $0.9823877638$ | $2.95\times10^{-16}$ |
| 12 | $0.0918066564$ | $0.9893250830$ | $1.71\times10^{-16}$ |
| 24 | $0.0669851117$ | $0.9922225625$ | $1.46\times10^{-16}$ |

The null is not near the $0.03$ binding threshold and does not improve with the sampling ladder.

The same selected photon geometry was continued through every declared speed
rather than re-optimized at each speed. Every row has correct neutral charge
and converged causal roots, but every row fails binding. At $u/c_f=0.9999$, the
row has $\epsilon_{\rm bind}=0.9999005117$.

**Measured:** the best photon sampling ladder ends at
$\epsilon_{\rm bind}=0.9922225625$. The electron rest target reports
$\epsilon_{\rm bind}=0.9999927135$, and its replay stays within
$3.1\times10^{-7}$ of one. Both are far outside the declared $0.03$ gate.

- **Non-canonical occupancy.** Roughly half the photon rows use occupancy
  $(3,2,3)$ — 8 architrinos per braid, 16 per assembly — and the
  ordinal-alternating polarity assignment gives each 3-site ring net charge
  $\pm1$ and each braid net $\pm2$; the assembly is neutral only because the
  anti braid flips signs.

owning_definition_quotes.quote: **The canonical force is central; there is no separate magnetic force.** The per-hit law (master-equation.md §"receiver-normal branch factor") is $\mathbf A=\kappa\sigma|q_iq_j|/r^2\,W^{\mathrm{rec}}\,\hat{\mathbf r}$ with $W^{\mathrm{rec}}=|D_T/D_s|$, $D_T=c_f-\hat{\mathbf r}\cdot\mathbf V_i$, $D_s=c_f-\hat{\mathbf r}\cdot\mathbf V_j(t_e)$, and the Lemma (Circular receiver-normal cancellation) gives $D_T=D_s\Rightarrow W^{\mathrm{rec}}=1$ on every nondegenerate rigid-circular root.

owning_definition_quotes.quote: **Result 3 — the honest net self-torque is $+0.424$, a HELD-SEED diagnostic; the self-hit is the coincidence only.** The whole-braid net secular z-torque, summed over all six sites from the delayed partner wake with the complete certifier (max residual $\sim10^{-15}$, root count stable, no unstable hits) and period-averaged (transient-free), is $+0.424$ — $N_t$-converged and soft-robust, concentrated on the middle ($M=+0.4229$; $I,O\approx0$). The self-hit is the **analytic coincidence only**: at $\beta_M=1$ the self chart obeys $\sin\xi=\xi/\beta$, which has no positive-delay root for $\beta\le1$; a branch is born only for $\beta=1+\mu$ at $\xi_0\approx\sqrt{6\mu}$ — the certifier confirms this onset (measured $\xi_0=0.344$ at $\mu=0.02$ vs $\sqrt{0.12}=0.346$; $0.538$ at $\mu=0.05$ vs $0.548$), so the numerical self channel is **not** independently reconstructed at the caustic — only the coincidence stratum, labeled `analyticNoPositiveDelaySelfHitAtExactBetaOne`. The §81 "$+0.142$" is exactly $+0.424-0.667\times0.4229$: the held-seed partner torque minus the §66 *maximum* brake applied algebraically. The $+0.424$ is the **internal partner torque on the held rigid seed**; the **external holding torque a prescribed rigid V5 worldline requires** is $-0.424$. Root COMPLETENESS (not just residual) is now tested and clean; the labels are held-seed diagnostics, not "root-certified free-particle" quantities. **Claim level: the held-seed torque is a robust measurement; the free-particle self-torque is unmeasured (needs a native force-free release).**

**Single-braid regressions.** Removing either partner recovers the source runner exactly. In a common sign convention,

$$
\dot L_{z,+}=+0.4240300292341333,
\qquad
\dot L_{z,-}=-0.4240300292341333,
$$

owning_definition_quotes.quote: **Declared ansatz.** The primary geometry is an axially stacked coaxial pair on the shared axis $\hat{\mathbf z}$, with axial separation $\Delta z=1$ in middle-radius units and relative phase $\Delta\phi=\pi$. The comparison geometry is coincident-coaxial, $\Delta z=0$, with the same relative phase. The pro copy has rotation sense $s=+1$; the anti copy has $s=-1$ and sitewise polarity conjugation. These are explicit pairing hypotheses, not derived bound geometries.

**Measured geometry search.** The shared-record scan covers 96 cells: eight axial separations $\Delta z\in\{0.5,0.75,1,1.25,1.5,2,2.5,3\}$ and twelve relative phases over $[0,2\pi)$. Each static cell books all 72 directed cross-braid relations over four cycle samples. The selected refined cell has 288 retained roots, maximum root residual $9.97\times10^{-13}$, and minimum source-receiver distance $0.3288$, above the declared collision floor.

The coarse grid shows that the cross torque can pass through the magnitude required to cancel the intrinsic pump, but no coarse cell simultaneously closes the pump and axial rows. A two-variable Newton continuation then solves the individual pro-braid pump row and the relative axial-force row together. It converges in two corrections to

$$
\Delta z=1.419842173795055,
\qquad
\Delta\phi=3.8435815410366416.
$$

At that cell the cross torque transfers the intrinsic pump between the two braids rather than leaving it as ansatz bookkeeping:

$$
\dot L_{z,+}^{\mathrm{total}}=-1.27754\times10^{-4},
\qquad
\dot L_{z,-}^{\mathrm{total}}=+1.27754\times10^{-4}.
$$

The relative axial-force residual is $-5.42047\times10^{-4}$ and the common axial force is $-3.64\times10^{-16}$. Thus the cross-torque-completed pair genuinely closes the seed-grade axial pump and force ledgers at one non-colliding geometry. This is a pump/force equilibrium row, not yet a bound object.

owning_definition_quotes.quote:
**Source-normal denominator and receiver-normal branch factor:**

$$
D_{s,ij}(T;T_{\mathrm{em}})
\equiv
c_f-\mathbf V_j(T_{\mathrm{em}})\cdot \hat{\mathbf{r}}_{ij}(T;T_{\mathrm{em}}),
\qquad
D_{T,ij}(T;T_{\mathrm{em}})
\equiv
c_f-\mathbf V_i(T)\cdot \hat{\mathbf{r}}_{ij}(T;T_{\mathrm{em}})
$$

$$
W_{ij}^{\mathrm{rec}}(T;T_{\mathrm{em}})
\equiv
\left|
\frac{D_{T,ij}(T;T_{\mathrm{em}})}
{D_{s,ij}(T;T_{\mathrm{em}})}
\right|
$$

**Per-hit acceleration contribution:**

$$
\mathbf A_{ij}(T; T_{\mathrm{em}})
=
\kappa \, \sigma_{ij} \,
\frac{|q_i q_j|}{r_{ij}^2}
W_{ij}^{\mathrm{rec}}(T;T_{\mathrm{em}})
\, \hat{\mathbf{r}}_{ij}
$$

owning_definition_quotes.quote: All geometric normalization factors (e.g., $1/(4\pi)$ from spherical surface area and overall $1/c_f$ factors from $\delta$-function change-of-variables) are absorbed into the coupling constant $\kappa$ by convention. The canonical per-hit law is therefore written with an explicit inverse-square factor together with the dimensionless receiver-normal branch factor $W_{ij}^{\mathrm{rec}}$.

owning_definition_quotes.quote:
For calculations that need continuity with electric-charge bookkeeping, each architrino carries an effective signed unit
$$
q_a=\sigma_a\epsilon,
\qquad
\sigma_a\in\{-1,+1\}
$$
The observer-level electron-charge benchmark is then
$$
|e|=6\epsilon
$$

- **Electrino:** negative-polarity architrino, with bookkeeping label $q_a=-\epsilon$.
- **Positrino:** positive-polarity architrino, with bookkeeping label $q_a=+\epsilon$.
The chapter keeps $c_f$ explicit in formulas; setting $c_f=1$ is a nondimensional convention, not a change in the causal law.
| Wake speed | $c_f$ | Set to 1 in natural units unless otherwise stated | $\mathrm{L}\,\mathrm{T}^{-1}$ | Propagation speed in the causal constraint |

section99_per_hit_weight_convention.formula: F_contribution = strength_rec * strength_src * polarity_rec * polarity_src * (D_T * D_s) / (D_s^2 + soft^2) / r^2, applied along the unit vector d = (receiverPoint - sourcePoint)/r (delayed source point toward receiver point), summed over all causal roots of the pair

section99_per_hit_weight_convention.convention: the soft regulator is applied to the source-normal factor D_s ONLY, in the signed form W_soft = D_T * D_s / (D_s^2 + soft^2) (no absolute value; attraction/repulsion is carried by the polarity product). The r^2 factor is NOT regularized: no soft term enters the distance denominator.

section99_distance_floor.convention: roots with r <= 1e-8 are skipped entirely (hard per-root floor, literal 1e-8: the guard is if (!(root.distance > 1e-8)) continue). The declared collisionFloor = 0.04 does NOT enter the weight; it is a separate pass/fail gate on the minimum booked root distance (gates.collisionFree: minDistance >= collisionFloor).

section96_per_hit_weight_convention.formula: F_contribution = polarity_rec * polarity_src * (receiverNormalNumerator * sourceNormalDenominator) / (sourceNormalDenominator^2 + soft^2) / distance^2, along the same source-point-to-receiver-point unit vector; identical algebraic placement of soft, with soft = 0.02 and the same 1e-8 distance skip. Section 96 sites carry no strength field (unit strength implicit).

notes: This resolves the reduction blocker: the declared regulator convention in both bookings is W_soft = D_T * D_s / (D_s^2 + soft^2), i.e. regularization of the 1/D_s branch factor only, signed, with the inverse-square distance factor left exact above the 1e-8 hard floor.
